tasks.check: grep -q 'VERSIONS_DONE' welcome-diff.txt || { echo 'FAIL: probe did not finish'; tail -5 welcome-diff.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'LATEST_VERSION=[0-9]+' welcome-diff.txt || { echo 'FAIL: could not determine latest pathway version'; grep LATEST_VERSION welcome-diff.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q -- '--- v123 welcome-bearing texts' welcome-diff.txt || { echo 'FAIL: v123 welcome extraction section missing'; exit 1; }; grep -vq 'NO_WELCOME_FOUND' <(grep -A2 -- '--- v123' welcome-diff.txt) || true; grep -q 'MK2 Optical' welcome-diff.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no welcome text extracted from any version — extraction heuristic broken'; exit 1; }; echo "MEASURED: $(grep -m1 'LATEST_VERSION=' welcome-diff.txt)"
tasks.verified: The pathway's full version list read live (proving whether Ankit's welcome-message edit minted a version newer than the bound v123), with the actual welcome copy extracted from v123 and from the newest version side by side so the orchestrator can show Ankit his new text and name the exact version to bind.
